point.title: 人称代词和物主代词
point.summary: 人称代词:作主语用主格(I/we/he…),作宾语或表语用宾格(me/us/him…);单独作答或带 not 的简短回答常用宾格(—Who is it? —Me.);it 可表时间/天气/距离。物主代词:形容词性(my/our/your/his/her/its/their)用在名词前;名词性(mine/ours/yours/his/hers/its/theirs)独立使用,代替“形容词性+名词”。
point.examples: He doesn't believe me. / It's a fine day today. / The red one is yours (= your pen).

questions.stem: ____ am a middle school student now.
questions.explanation: 作主语用主格 I。

questions.stem: My grandpa often tells ____ good stories.
questions.explanation: 作宾语用宾格 me。

questions.stem: ____ school uniform is blue and white.
questions.explanation: 名词 uniform 前用形容词性物主代词 my。

questions.stem: Tom is my classmate. ____ is good at maths.
questions.explanation: 作主语用主格 He；He's=He is。

questions.stem: Our teacher helps ____ with English every day.
questions.explanation: 作宾语用宾格 us。

questions.stem: The students are cleaning ____ classroom now.
questions.explanation: 名词 classroom 前用形容词性物主代词 their。

questions.stem: Lily loves ____ new bike very much.
questions.explanation: 名词 bike 前用形容词性物主代词 her。

questions.stem: We all love ____ school.
questions.explanation: 名词 school 前用形容词性物主代词 our。

questions.stem: Welcome to our school! Nice to meet ____!
questions.explanation: meet 后作宾语用宾格 you。

questions.stem: This blue pen isn't yours. It's ____.
questions.explanation: 名词性物主代词 mine 代替 my pen。

questions.stem: ____ is sunny and warm today.
questions.explanation: it 可表天气。

questions.stem: — Is this schoolbag ____? — Yes, it's mine.
questions.explanation: 名词性物主代词 yours 代替 your schoolbag。

questions.stem: — Who is at the door? — ____.
questions.explanation: 单独作答常用宾格 Me；主格一般不单独使用。规则依据教材 印136 例句 —Who is it? —Me.（本题为改编，非原句）。

questions.stem: This is our school library. ____ reading room is very big.
questions.explanation: its 修饰名词 reading room 表“它的”；It's=It is；library 单数不用 Their。（避开宠物 he/she 成立的歧义）

questions.stem: These red shoes are ____, not mine.
questions.explanation: 名词性物主代词 hers 代替 her shoes；无 her's 写法。

questions.stem: This is Peter's eraser. The eraser is ____.
questions.explanation: his 兼形容词性/名词性，此处名词性代替 his eraser。

questions.stem: My sister and I share a room. The bed near the window is ____.
questions.explanation: 名词性物主代词 mine 代替 my bed。

questions.stem: Lily can't find her ruler. Can you give ____ mine? ____ needs it now.
questions.explanation: give 后接宾格 her（间接宾语）；第二空作主语用主格 She。

questions.stem: Anna has a red schoolbag and I have a blue one. The red one is ____, and the blue one is ____.
questions.explanation: 独立使用代替 Anna's bag / my bag，用名词性物主代词 hers 和 mine。

questions.stem: My parents work hard. I love ____, and ____ love me too.
questions.explanation: love 后接宾格 them；第二空作主语用主格 they。
